subject: More achievements...
author: Xandu
body:
Here are some Paradise achievements:

100G - The True Elite - Get 2000 Hours+ of game play.
500G - Circuit breaker - Create a lapped race in the route editor and send it to the mail bag.
50G - Endurace racer - Win a ranked race that is longer than 5 minutes.
25G - Master racer - Win a race without using the hand brake, without using boost, without taking anyone down and without crashing.
25G - The A button - You discovered boost!
20G - You rock! - 2 hours+ of game play.
5G - Content Burner - Drive around in Paradise City for more than 1 hour without complaining about the fog and laggy takedowns.
5G - Lost civilization - Discover the lost population of Paradise City.
0G - Beach bum - Jump into the sea by the ferris wheel and reach the buoys.
0G - Master Rider - Accumulate more than 500 miles driving on one wheel on any motorbike.  

-- The Creator --
